story_log.title: Rays beat Guardians 7-3 in ALCS Game 6, advance to World Series to face Brewers — first-time champion guaranteed
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 14, TIER 1 ELIMINATION GAME, RESOLVED]: Tampa Bay beat Cleveland 7-3 per ground truth, won series 4-2 per ground truth. Rays advance to World Series to face Milwaukee Brewers per ground truth. First World Series matchup between two teams that have never won a title in over 100 years (last: Phillies-Royals 1980) per ESPN. Freddy Peralta named ALCS MVP after two starts including Game 6 clincher, plus one relief appearance per CBS Sports. Peralta acquired from Mets at trade deadline, turnaround propelled Rays to Fall Classic per CBS Sports. Tampa Bay last World Series appearance 2020 per ground truth. Cleveland last won title 1948, last appearance 2016 per ground truth. Brewers swept Dodgers 4-0 in NLCS per recent history. One of these two teams will win first championship in franchise history.

story_log.title: 49ers stay unbeaten at 6-0 with 23-17 win over Commanders — Jayden Daniels throws ball away on 4th down, Terry McLaurin carted off with knee injury
story_log.development: San Francisco beat Washington 23-17 per ground truth. 49ers now 6-0, 1st in NFC West per ground truth — second 6-0 start under Kyle Shanahan per ESPN. Commanders fall to 1-4-1, 4th in NFC East, 2 games back per ground truth. Jayden Daniels threw ball away on 4th down in second quarter per ghetto_gronk/ESPN — even Dan Quinn didn't know it was 4th down per ghetto_gronk. Second straight week Daniels made inexcusable mental error (forgot he had no timeouts last week) per ghetto_gronk. Terry McLaurin carted off after knee injury late in first quarter per AdamSchefter/CBS Sports — 'there's fear' of significant injury per CBS Sports. Mike Evans (49ers WR) ruled out with Achilles injury after leaving game late in first half per AdamSchefter/CBS Sports. CMC: 30+ fantasy points, only player to score 30+ in Week 6 per SleeperHQ. George Kittle dominant 9 months removed from torn Achilles per SleeperHQ. NFC East made history going two straight weeks without a win (0-6-2 since Week 5) per AdamSchefter/CBS Sports — first division ever to go winless in consecutive weeks.

story_log.title: Angel Reese dominates Game 2 with 30-16 as Dream even WNBA Finals 1-1 — 'I need the ball' fueled one of best Finals performances in history
story_log.development: Atlanta beat Golden State 79-65 per ground truth. Reese: 30 PTS, 16 REB per CBS Sports — demanded the ball and delivered one of the best performances in WNBA Finals history per CBS Sports. Series now tied 1-1, Game 3 next per ground truth. 'I need the ball': Inside what fueled Angel Reese per CBS Sports. Dream bounced back after Game 1 loss.

story_log.title: NFC East makes history going winless in consecutive weeks — 0-6-2 since Week 5, first division ever to achieve this futility
story_log.development: NFC East went 0-3-1 in Week 6 (49ers beat Commanders 23-17, other games earlier in week) per ground truth/AdamSchefter. Division now 0-6-2 since Week 5 per CBS Sports — first division ever to go winless in consecutive weeks per CBS Sports. Giants 3-1-1 lead division per ground truth. Eagles 2-4, Cowboys 2-4, Commanders 1-4-1 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Lakers waive 2024 first-round pick Dalton Knecht — former No. 17 pick falls hard after fast start, Bronny James survives roster cut
story_log.development: LA Lakers waived Knecht per CBS Sports/KevinOConnor — 2024 first-round pick (No. 17) now off roster day before 2026-27 season begins per CBS Sports. Already 25 years old, was late bloomer in college after multiple transfers per KevinOConnor. Things turned after reversed Mark Williams trade per KevinOConnor. Four lottery picks from 2024 draft already traded, Knecht now waived per CBS Sports — '2024 draft class was doomed from the start' per CBS Sports. Bronny James kept Lakers roster spot over Knecht per CBS Sports — with father on 76ers, James is last survivor of Lakers' 2024 draft class per CBS Sports. Wild how far Knecht has fallen after fast start to career per KevinOConnor.

story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 4]: Philadelphia lost to Colorado 3-2 per ground truth. Flyers now 2-9 after 11 games, their worst start in franchise history (since 1967-68) per ground truth. Philadelphia historically bad to open season.

story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Eagles and Hurts' agent revealed more information about quarterback's blood clot situation Monday per CBS Sports. Still lingering questions about star QB's health per CBS Sports. Hurts on injured reserve per recent history. Story continues to develop.

story_log.development: Evans ruled out with Achilles injury after leaving game late in first half per AdamSchefter/CBS Sports. Was having good first half before exiting per CBS Sports. 49ers lose receiver.

story_log.development: Washington fears McLaurin suffered 'significant' knee injury during MNF loss per AdamSchefter. Carted off after knee injury late in first quarter per CBS Sports. Commanders WR facing potential long-term issue.

story_log.title: Guardians head home after ALCS loss — biggest offseason questions about José Ramírez, Steven Kwan, core players

After losing to Rays in ALCS, headed home with major questions about several core players per CBS Sports. José Ramírez, Steven Kwan among key names per CBS Sports. Offseason begins for Guardians.

lead_story.headline: Rays Beat Guardians, Head to World Series vs Brewers — First-Time Champion Guaranteed

tweets.text:
THE RAYS ARE MOVING ON TO THE FALL CLASSIC!

Tampa Bay closes out the Guardians at home and will now face the Milwaukee Brewers for a WS title 🍿

Brewers. Rays. One team will win it all for the first time ever! 🔥

It’s just the second World Series in the last 100 years between teams that have never won a title (Phillies-Royals 1980).

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 14]: Reader knows Rays-Guardians ALCS has been ongoing, Tampa Bay won series 4-2. Skip the series recap. Lead with ONLY what is new today: Rays won Game 6 7-3, clinched pennant, advance to World Series to face Milwaukee Brewers. The FIRST-TIME CHAMPION guarantee is the biggest angle — research this: it is just the second World Series in the last 100 years between two teams that have never won a title (Phillies-Royals 1980 is the only other). That rarity IS the story. Freddy Peralta named ALCS MVP after being acquired from Mets at trade deadline — his turnaround propelled Rays to Fall Classic. Rank this drought matchup: Tampa Bay last World Series appearance 2020, never won. Cleveland last won 1948, last appearance 2016. How does a 78-year drought (Guardians) stack up against a franchise that has never won (Rays, founded 1998)? Compare to other long title droughts across major sports. The Fall Classic begins with a guarantee: one of these two fanbases will celebrate their first championship ever.
